reports.title: Cordell Hull fishing report
reports.text: Bass- Fishing is decent. Anglers are having success catching fish around creek/slough mouths. With the water level dropping, and a little bit of flow on the main channel, bass are starting to stack on muddy banks and especially wood in the creek mouths. Any shad style reaction bait would work, or fishing slow with shaky heads or jigs. Some nice fish have been caught fishing the edges of what’s left of the grass. Throwing a spinnerbait, topwater spook, swimbait or something baitfish oriented on the sharp edges of the grass can produce a big bite if there is wind or baitfish in the grass. You can still get plenty of bites while fishing the main channel, rock banks with jigs or finesse baits…
reports.by: Will Schibig, Region III Creel Clerk

reports.title: Kentucky Lake fishing report
reports.text:
Winter winds are coming, says the weatherman, that may put the brakes on the wonderful fall fishing that had crappie anglers scoring good stringers plus nice catches reported by cat fishermen lately along the main river channel.
Decent numbers of crappie had been showing up in the creel as they dunked jigs tipped with minnows in midrange depths of 9 to 14 feet.
Bass fishing has been fair for anglers tossing Rattle Traps, shallow running crankbaits, twister tail grubs and some aggressive topwater at times. Gravel banks and big chunk rocky points have been producing as have rip-rap levees and gravel roadbeds. It’s time to batten down the hatches and dig out the coveralls and big thick coats…

reports.title: Watts Bar Reservoir fishing report
reports.text: Crappie: Fishing for crappie is starting to pick up with anglers finding success over deeper brush structures in creeks/inlets off the main lake. Baits used are small jigging minnows (Bobby Garland, Kietech, etc.) or small live minnows. Lower water temperatures and shortened day length have signaled crappie to start their fall feed in preparation for winter. In the fall, baitfish like Threadfin Shad start to push back into creeks to find warmer water and zooplankton. Crappie are following this food source making them easier to target.
reports.by: Nathan Rogers, Region III Creel Clerk

reports.title: Nickajack 11/5/26 fishing report
reports.text:
The fishing has been great the past few weeks the bass are really starting to key in on bait making them pretty easy to track down and you can throw about whatever you want to catch them.
A lot of times you won’t actually see the fish schooling on the bait all that will be going on under the surface but you can for sure just track down moving bait balls and windblown banks and capitalize on some of these schools of bass if you don’t have a front looker on your back to search around for them
It’s firing good on the last little bit of good fall grass fishing we are going to have so you can still go out with the big rods and braid and lay a whooping down on some bass in the grass.

reports.title: Center Hill 10/29/26 fishing report
reports.text:
Bass Report – Quality Smallmouth & Topwater Action! We've been catching some very nice smallmouth bass on crankbaits in 25–30 feet of water! The topwater bite is also getting very good, providing some exciting action for anglers who enjoy watching bass explode on the surface. If you're looking for quality smallmouth or some exciting topwater action, Center Hill Lake is worth checking out!
Crappie Report – Giant Crappie Are Showing Up! We've recently caught some giant crappie around the 30-foot range, along with some smaller fish up shallow. It's always exciting to see those big slabs! With crappie being caught in different parts of the water column, there's an opportunity to target both…
